rule_claims.title: Blood Reversal — Denied Recovery
rule_claims.trigger: target with two source-owned Severing Wound stacks begins a registered temporary heal event
rule_claims.resolution: Contest that one healing effect instance via normal Authority/priority; on win, negate only that instance and restore 6 Red Tithe; on loss healing proceeds. No damage conversion.
rule_claims.once: one target event per 5s and maximum two successful negations per field
rule_claims.success_visual: Crimson inverted rose freezes ONE incoming gold/heal thread which breaks into cobalt dust
rule_claims.failure_visual: inverted rose collapses; original healing thread completes

rule_claims.title: Thorn Unbinding — Broken Continuation
rule_claims.trigger: observed eligible temporary regeneration or summon-maintenance tether linked to a target with ≥3 Rupture Seals
rule_claims.resolution: Consume three marks only upon a successful contest; sever only chosen temporary instance. A failed contest preserves marks but costs the committed resource.
rule_claims.success_visual: Three sapphire nails pin the actual tether, then cut its center; tether vanishes
rule_claims.failure_visual: nails shatter and the intact tether returns visibly

rule_claims.title: Mirror Debt — No Returned Wound
rule_claims.trigger: observed eligible reflected-damage copy would apply to Alter during field; original enemy attack already legitimately resolved
rule_claims.resolution: Contest ONLY the reflected-damage copy and negate on win. Cannot erase original hit, original counterattack, unobserved effect, or independent authored reflect rules.
rule_claims.success_visual: A mirrored scarlet blade appears over her shoulder, then cracks without impact
rule_claims.failure_visual: mirror fracture turns red and the reflected event proceeds

rule_claims.title: Boundary Decree — The Unwritten Margin
rule_claims.trigger: World Fantasm/Domain overlaps the field at a physically intersecting boundary
rule_claims.resolution: Per-segment priority/strength/compatibility contest, not globally guaranteed. Winning boundary sector permits only that spatial rule overlay to persist; lost sector retracts. Other rules remain intact.
rule_claims.once: repeat on actual boundary changes, stable deterministic ordering
rule_claims.success_visual: Black ribs advance with blue rose vertices, displacing only contested local geometry
rule_claims.failure_visual: black ribs bend inward and dissolve, showing opposing field intact

world_fantasm.rules: Negates precisely one eligible effect instance when a contest succeeds; no generic suppression of all debuffs, immunity or superior Authority; no world-scale automatic win
world_fantasm.field_end: Only field overlays collapse; inflicted damage/injuries/physical consequences persist
